control_flow: followInTheDark: if RLIGHT is below 60, follow the line or call avoidWalls; otherwise call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 70, turn away from a left or right obstacle, else call driveInTheDark; otherwise call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70, drive forward; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: curve left on black, otherwise curve right.
